item: Row 373 (2 of 2): pypdf 6.21.4, soupsieve 4.1.3, anyio 4.14.2, urllib3 2.8.0, certifi 2026.10.18, the other 32 advisories Audit 17 SEC-1 listed
summary: pip-audit 2.10.1 against requirements.lock listed 32 advisories on five locked packages besides pillow (part 1): pypdf 6.19.0 (18, all fixed by 6.21.4), soupsieve 2.8.4 (6, fixed across 2.9.0, 2.10.0, 3.0.2 and 4.0.0, so only the 4 line fixes all; 4.1.3 also carries the 4.1.x fixes for quadratic-time selectors), anyio 4.14.0 (3, 4.14.2), urllib3 2.7.0 (3, 2.8.0) and certifi 2026.6.17 (2, 2026.10.18). Each lock block carries its PyPI hashes; pip-audit on the new set finds none of the 32. Floors move where the app parses untrusted input or the advisory is on its own HTTP stack: pypdf >=6.21.4 (core and the pdf extra) and urllib3 >=2.8.0,<2.8.1, with the urllib3-log-shapes registry pin, its couplings, EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCIES.md and the crypto job's floor venv moved to 2.8.0 together (the log-shape table was already read on 2.8.0, so no table change). soupsieve 4 is a major version: its breaks are template/iframe scoping and a stricter :has(), and the only app selectors are two fixed MediaWiki diff selectors and the operator's market rule, whose refusal is already reported as an invalid CSS selector. The CI lock-install job was replayed locally: hash-checked install, import smoke, mypy on the lock pins and pip check all clean.
